description: Sixteen band vocoder: the band levels read from the modifier input are imposed on the matching bands of the carrier.

params.text: Sets how much of that band reaches the output, 0 to 2; the sixteen bands run from 125Hz to 6400Hz.
Sets how fast the band envelope followers rise; turning it up slows the rise.
Sets how fast the band envelope followers fall; turning it up slows the fall.
Sets the Q of the sixteen filters the carrier is split with, 1 to 15; the default is 5.
Sets the Q of the sixteen filters the modifier is split with, 1 to 15; the default is 5.
Shifts which modifier band drives which carrier band, -15 to 15 bands, wrapping round the ends.
Sets the gain applied to the modifier input before it is split into bands, 1 to 10.
Sets the gain applied to the carrier input before it is split into bands, 1 to 10.
Sets the gain applied to the summed bands on the way out, 1 to 10.
Scales the CV for the control it serves, -100% to 100%; negative settings invert the CV.
Turns each band level upside down, so quiet modifier bands open the carrier and loud ones close it.

inputs.text: Sets the level of that carrier band from a patched voltage, 0-5V; with nothing patched the modifier band of the same number sets it.
The signal whose band levels are read, usually a voice or something else with moving harmonics.
The signal the band levels are imposed on, usually something synthetic and harmonically rich.
Adds to the rise time of the band envelope followers, scaled by its attenuverter.
Adds to the fall time of the band envelope followers, scaled by its attenuverter.
Adds to the Q of the carrier filters, one step per volt before the attenuverter.
Adds to the Q of the modifier filters, one step per volt before the attenuverter; the module reads this jack only while the DECAY input is patched.
A trigger here shifts the bands one step down, wrapping round the ends.
A trigger here shifts the bands one step up, wrapping round the ends.
Adds to the band shift, one band per volt before the attenuverter.

outputs.text: The level the envelope follower reads from that band of the modifier input, 0-5V.
The vocoded signal, the carrier bands summed at the levels read from the modifier.

notes: each modifier band output is normalled to the carrier band input of the same number, so the vocoder works with nothing patched into the band jacks.

inputs.22: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.23: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
